items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I worked with him. And Ruth Crowder, his wife... I worked for Ruth and Sax, well, we were -- I guess we was together a couple years.

ctx.x: Yeah, I worked with him. And Ruth Crowder, his wife. And Henderson Smith, trumpet player. We had a nice little four piece band. We were on the Westside.
Did you have offers to go with other big bands, after Earl broke up?
